tools.name: discover_tools
tools.label: Load assistant tools
tools.description: Load only the needed tool definitions for this request; never execute the selected tools.

tools.name: end_conversation
tools.label: End this turn
tools.description: Deliver a final answer and stop this run without blocking future messages or changing account access.

tools.name: get_service_facts
tools.label: Service connection and activities
tools.description: Read current connection endpoints, console activities and key setup guidance.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.label: Open a console page
tools.description: Suggest a permitted console page without submitting its forms.

tools.name: get_setup_guide
tools.label: Client setup guidance
tools.description: Read setup steps for the chosen client, device and live model ID.

tools.name: search_web
tools.label: Search the web
tools.description: Search through the configured provider; results cannot authorize account changes.

tools.name: calculate_math
tools.label: Arithmetic calculator
tools.description: Evaluate bounded arithmetic expressions without shell or database access.

tools.name: get_account_access
tools.label: Account access and progress
tools.description: Read your current access level, wallet balance and recorded setup progress.

tools.name: get_user_overview
tools.label: Account overview
tools.description: Read your account overview, or an authorized administrator view.

tools.name: get_user_usage_summary
tools.label: Account usage details
tools.description: Read bounded account usage statistics for the permitted account.

tools.name: get_usage_summary
tools.label: Usage summary
tools.description: Read your current model and group usage summary.

tools.name: prepare_user_action
tools.label: Prepare an account action
tools.description: Prepare a secure form for supported profile or account actions; the user must confirm.

tools.name: grant_l1_access
tools.label: Grant verified L1 access
tools.description: Activate only the current L0 account after server-checked conversation and registration requirements.

tools.name: get_available_models
tools.label: Available models
tools.description: Read live public model IDs for L0, or usable model IDs for an authorized account.

tools.name: get_model_pricing
tools.label: Model pricing
tools.description: Read live pricing for one exact model and permitted routing group.

tools.name: calculate_cost
tools.label: Cost estimate
tools.description: Calculate an estimate from supplied token counts and verified prices.

tools.name: get_plan_offers
tools.label: Plans and top-up offers
tools.description: Read current offers while retaining the L0 payment-intent and checkout restrictions.

tools.name: request_create_key
tools.label: Prepare API key creation
tools.description: Prepare a browser confirmation for a key in a permitted group; never reveal it in chat.

tools.name: list_my_api_keys
tools.label: List your API key metadata
tools.description: Read your key IDs, names and status without exposing credentials.

tools.name: prepare_api_key_action
tools.label: Prepare API key revocation
tools.description: Prepare deletion or disabling of one exact owned key; confirmation and secure verification remain required.

tools.name: send_invitation
tools.label: Send an invitation
tools.description: Prepare an invitation email using your own referral link; send only after confirmation.

tools.name: get_invitation_rewards
tools.label: Invitation rewards
tools.description: Read your invitation reward status and the current reward rules.

tools.name: get_new_user_gift_status
tools.label: Welcome gift status
tools.description: Read a stored gift decision without evaluating or claiming a gift.

tools.name: prepare_new_user_gift
tools.label: Grant a welcome gift
tools.description: Grant a bounded welcome gift directly; the server prevents duplicate credit. Zero creates no new decision.

tools.name: get_weekly_discount_status
tools.label: Weekly discount status
tools.description: Read the current stored weekly decision without changing it.

tools.name: prepare_weekly_discount
tools.label: Evaluate a weekly discount
tools.description: Record a server-checked weekly decision and prepare its claim card.

tools.name: get_bounty_guide
tools.label: Bounty guidance
tools.description: Read the workflow for publishing, funding, reviewing and settling bounties.

tools.name: get_bounty_data
tools.label: Bounty data
tools.description: Read public bounty data or authorized private and administrator views; never fund or settle a bounty.

tools.name: get_store_products
tools.label: Product catalogue
tools.description: Read visible store products without buying or issuing credentials.

tools.name: get_store_product
tools.label: Product details
tools.description: Read one visible product and its purchase requirements.

tools.name: get_tool_market_services
tools.label: MCP service catalogue
tools.description: Read tool-market service listings without loading, authorizing or invoking their tools.

tools.name: get_tool_market_service
tools.label: MCP service details
tools.description: Read one service and its published tool metadata without invoking it.

tools.name: prepare_image_generation
tools.label: Prepare image generation
tools.description: Prepare a drawing confirmation using current permitted models; generation may charge the wallet after confirmation.

tools.name: get_human_support_status
tools.label: Support eligibility and requests
tools.description: Read your support eligibility and active in-site request.

tools.name: book_technical_support
tools.label: Request a support appointment
tools.description: Create an in-site appointment only after an explicit booking request and server-checked recharge eligibility.

tools.name: request_human_support
tools.label: Prepare human support or account review
tools.description: Prepare an in-site handoff or account-disable review request; the user must confirm.

tools.name: get_overview_greeting
tools.label: Read overview greeting
tools.description: Read your localized overview templates and supported variables.

tools.name: set_overview_greeting
tools.label: Edit overview greeting
tools.description: Prepare a change to your own localized greeting without changing other settings.

tools.name: set_conversation_title
tools.label: Conversation title
tools.description: Store a short title for the current new conversation without account changes.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.label: Recall your memories
tools.description: Read only your own relevant long-term memories.

tools.name: remember_memory
tools.label: Remember a preference
tools.description: Store a bounded durable preference or project detail for your account; secrets are prohibited.

tools.name: remember_profile_skill
tools.label: Save a response preference
tools.description: Store a coarse response-style preference without changing permissions or billing.

tools.name: forget_profile_skill
tools.label: Forget an AI response preference
tools.description: Remove only your AI-created response preference after your explicit request.

tools.name: get_registration_risk
tools.label: Registration eligibility check
tools.description: Read server-verified evidence for the current L0 account.

tools.name: notify_registration_risk
tools.label: Record a registration alert
tools.description: Record a bounded in-site risk alert only from server-verified registration evidence.

tools.name: end_registration_conversation
tools.label: Hold an unsafe registration
tools.description: Hold the current L0 registration flow only when deterministic server checks require it.

tools.name: ban_l0_user
tools.label: Suspend an abusive L0 account
tools.description: Suspend only the current L0 account when matching server evidence and the global suspension cap permit it.

tools.name: get_admin_user_skills
tools.label: Read user personalization
tools.description: Read permitted account profiles and memories with live administrator authority.

tools.name: get_admin_server_config
tools.label: Read server settings
tools.description: Read allowed server configuration without secrets; root authority is required.

tools.name: get_admin_channels
tools.label: Read routing channels
tools.description: Read bounded channel configuration without provider credentials.

tools.name: get_admin_model_inventory
tools.label: Read model inventory
tools.description: Read enabled model IDs, routing groups and missing local metadata.

tools.name: list_admin_operations
tools.label: Discover console operations
tools.description: Read exact permitted console operation metadata; generic execution remains read-only.

tools.name: execute_admin_operation
tools.label: Run a console read operation
tools.description: Run one discovered read operation with current route permissions; writes and disabled tool aliases are rejected.

tools.name: audit_admin_model_pricing
tools.label: Audit model pricing
tools.description: Inspect supported model pricing without modifying prices.

tools.name: prepare_admin_user_skill_change
tools.label: Prepare user personalization changes
tools.description: Prepare an exact administrator preview for supported profile or memory changes.

tools.name: prepare_admin_config_change
tools.label: Prepare server setting changes
tools.description: Prepare allowlisted server settings with root authority and explicit browser confirmation.

tools.name: prepare_admin_channel_change
tools.label: Prepare channel changes
tools.description: Prepare validated channel changes while preserving role and secret restrictions.

tools.name: prepare_admin_model_sync
tools.label: Prepare model metadata import
tools.description: Verify selected upstream model IDs and prepare a root-only metadata import.

tools.name: prepare_admin_pricing_change
tools.label: Prepare model pricing changes
tools.description: Prepare exact pricing changes with root authority and explicit browser confirmation.

tools.name: get_site_issues
tools.label: Read issue status
tools.description: Read your visible reports and updates; administrators can read all reports.

tools.name: create_site_issue
tools.label: Create an improvement issue
tools.description: Prepare a bug, security, experience or feature report for confirmation.

tools.name: update_site_issue
tools.label: Update issue status
tools.description: Prepare an administrator update with status, visibility and a note.

tools.name: get_connected_market_tools
tools.label: Read connected market tools
tools.description: Read allowed services, exact schemas and your own current grants.

tools.name: connect_market_tool
tools.label: Authorize a market tool
tools.description: Prepare version-bound access and spending limits for browser confirmation.

tools.name: call_market_tool
tools.label: Use a connected market tool
tools.description: Call an allowed remote tool using your explicit bounded grant and the existing billing checks.

tools.name: show_chart
tools.label: Statistical chart
tools.description: Display a line, bar or donut chart from bounded data.

tools.name: show_statistics
tools.label: Statistic cards
tools.description: Display key values with labels and optional icons.

tools.name: show_choices
tools.label: Choice buttons
tools.description: Offer choices that fill the composer without submitting actions.

tools.name: show_flowchart
tools.label: Flow diagram
tools.description: Display a process using labelled steps and connections.

tools.name: get_site_policy
tools.label: Read site policy
tools.description: Read the published user agreement, privacy policy or refund policy with language, revision and page cursors.

tools.name: search_site_policies
tools.label: Search site policies
tools.description: Search the site's configured policy text without fetching external URLs.

tools.name: prepare_admin_site_policy_change
tools.label: Prepare site policy changes
tools.description: Prepare an exact policy edit; root authority, a fresh revision and explicit browser confirmation are required.
